agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: AI auto-responders. Assign one to a WhatsApp session and it replies to incoming 1:1 messages.
agents.name: Name
agents.soulPlaceholder: Who is this agent? Tone, character, voice. e.g. A warm, concise support rep for Acme who loves helping.
agents.instructionsPlaceholder: What should it do and not do? e.g. Answer product and pricing questions. Never quote a refund policy; offer to connect a human instead.
agents.apiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current key ({hint})
agents.apiKeyStoredNote: Stored encrypted. Used only to generate this agent’s replies.
agents.replyDelayNote: Waits a random time in this range before replying, showing a “typing…” indicator meanwhile. Feels more human than an instant answer.
agents.allowAutoStopNote: Give the agent a tool to pause itself on a conversation (hand off to a human) when it doesn’t know how to answer. You resume it from the conversation.
agents.mcpOpenaiNote: MCP tools aren’t available for OpenAI agents yet. Switch the provider to Anthropic to connect MCP servers.
agents.mcpOpenaiClearWarning: Saving will remove this agent’s configured MCP servers.
agents.mcpUpgrade: Give your agent tools via MCP servers — available on the Pro plan and higher. <link>Upgrade in Billing</link>.
agents.mcpNote: The agent can call tools on these MCP servers while replying (connections are made by Anthropic, billed to your API key). Only add servers you trust — tools act on whatever your contacts write.
agents.noAgents: No agents yet. Create one, then assign it to a session.
